description: Look up the name, symbol, decimals and total supply of an ERC-20 token contract on zkSync Era, live from the contract. Use to identify an unknown token address or to format raw amounts; for a holder's balance use zksync_token_balance. Input is the ticker USDC or the token's 0x contract address; an address that is not an ERC-20 contract returns 422, uncharged. Example: token=0x1d17CBcF0D6D143135aE902365D2E5e2A16538D4. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

token.description: Token: the ticker USDC, or the 0x ERC-20 contract address
